title: Register for Pay As You Go (PAYG) withholding
summary: This page explains what Pay As You Go (PAYG) withholding is and when you must register for it if you make payments to certain workers.
intro:
Pay As You Go (PAYG) withholding is a tax on your workers’ income that you help the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) to collect.

You need to withhold tax if you make payments to any of the following:

You must register for PAYG withholding before you need to make a payment that is subject to withholding.

Visit the ATO's PAYG withholding for more information.
